title: ECHOES：通过递归历史压缩与特权在线策略蒸馏超越当前图像
summary: 针对长程GUI智能体保留历史截图导致视觉token与推理成本上升、文本摘要丢失关键状态的问题，提出ECHOES：采用压缩-思考-行动（CTA）格式递归更新文本历史状态，并利用训练期特权多图输入作为教师，对学生生成的CTA轨迹进行token级在线策略蒸馏，结合PMF差距引导的OPD-RL框架动态平衡蒸馏与任务奖励，并发布EchoesBMK诊断基准。
summary_en: ECHOES addresses long-horizon GUI agents' trade-off between costly screenshot retention and lossy textual summaries. It uses a Compression-Think-Action format to recursively update textual history, and a privileged multi-image teacher providing dense token-level on-policy distillation on student rollouts, balanced by a PMF-Gap-guided OPD-RL framework. It also introduces ECHOESBMK, a diagnostic benchmark from real failure trajectories. Deployment needs no screenshots, achieving strong performance and positive zero-shot transfer.
